art_direction: Original transparent 3D cutouts for amiLudo: rounded matte clay/plastic, warm upper-left studio light, ivory/violet/mint/coral/amber palette, no UI frame, no brands or characters.

assets.name: dice
assets.prompt: Two rounded ivory and violet dice with recessed circular pips, tumbling together.

assets.name: pawns
assets.prompt: Three rounded spherical-head pawns in violet, coral and mint.

assets.name: numbers
assets.prompt: Three rounded violet, mint and coral blocks bearing white numerals 1, 2, 3.

assets.name: cards
assets.prompt: A fan of four rounded cards with original abstract circle, star, diamond and dot designs.

assets.name: hourglass
assets.prompt: A squat rounded ivory-and-violet hourglass, clear bulbs, amber sand.

assets.name: scores
assets.prompt: A mint clipboard/scoreboard with ivory rows, colored bars and counters, no text.

assets.name: wheel
assets.prompt: A six-sector violet/mint/coral/amber prize wheel on an ivory stand, no labels.

assets.name: coins
assets.prompt: Two chunky amber coins bearing raised stars with a violet accent.

assets.name: bag
assets.prompt: A mint cloth drawstring token bag with violet cord and amber/coral tokens.

assets.name: table
assets.prompt: A cohesive still life of dice, pawns, abstract cards and amber tokens for the welcome banner.
